(Provided by the reader) Central News Agency reporter Wang Chaozhuang Fax October 4, 115 Newtalk News (Central News Agency reporter Wang Chaozhuang Yilan 4) A building materials store on Yanshan Township Hot Spring Road in Yilan County had a fire on the evening of the 3rd. The fire was fierce and a lot of smoke was emanating from the scene. When the firefighters arrived, they rescued the mother of the owner, but the father, wife and a pair of sons and daughters lost their lives in the fire cave. At 10:36 p.m. on the 3rd, the Yilan County Fire Department received a call from the public on 119, indicating that a residential fire broke out in a 3-storey building opposite Yanshan Township Wenquan Road, Yanshan Central. Thick smoke broke out on the scene and people were trapped, requesting rescue.
